resources.string: Removes this profile and its favourites and history. Sources are kept.

Your profiles, playlists, favourites and history have NOT been deleted — this is a database upgrade failure, and the data is still on this device.\n\nPlease report this so it can be fixed, and include the message below.

Channels, movies and series from every playlist you show. Pick a result to go straight to it, then play, download or open its options there. TV programmes on now or later today are found by their title too.
Search looks in channel, movie and series names in the playlists you show. Hidden categories are not searched. TV programmes are found by their title in the downloaded guide.
Each profile keeps its own favourites and history
